payments.navigation.attention.label: Needs attention
payments.navigation.refunds.label: Refunds
payments.navigation.sessions.label: Till sessions
payments.navigation.providers.label: Providers and readers
payments.screens.session.waiting-help: These payments have no answer yet, so the session cannot be counted until each one has.
payments.screens.session.unknown-at: Started {started}. If nothing answers, it is marked unknown at {at} and can then be settled under Needs attention.
payments.screens.session.unknown-now: Started {started}. The provider has not answered, so someone needs to check it under Needs attention.
payments.screens.session.cash-up-help: Closing stops new payments in this session. It then waits below for its cash to be counted, and you can carry on selling in a new session.
payments.screens.session.close-help-no-c: Closing stops new payments in this session. No cash is taken, so there is nothing to count. A quiet session also closes itself.
payments.screens.session.handoff.succeed: The SumUp app says the payment went through
It has been recorded as paid.
payments.screens.session.handoff.failed: The SumUp app says the payment did not go through
payments.screens.session.handoff.failed-: Nothing was taken. Try again, or take payment another way.
payments.screens.session.handoff.unknown: The SumUp app did not say what happened
Check the payment in the SumUp app before trying again, so nobody pays twice.
payments.screens.close.title: Count and close
payments.screens.close.no-cash: No cash was taken in this session, so there is nothing to count.
payments.screens.close.counted-help: Everything in the drawer, float included.
payments.screens.close.reason-help: Say what you know, such as change given wrongly. The difference is recorded in the ledger.
payments.screens.sessions.chart-summary: The last {sessions} closed sessions, oldest first. Sessions with a difference: {differing}. Each figure is in the table below.
payments.screens.sessions.empty-help: A session starts by itself with a seller's first sale at the till, and is listed here with what it took.
payments.screens.attention.unknown-help: The provider has not said whether these went through. Check each one in the provider's own records, then say what happened. Whatever it holds stays held until you do.
payments.screens.attention.thing: the payment of {amount} through {provider} as settled
payments.screens.attention.succeeded-con: The payment counts as taken and what it was for is completed. If the money did not arrive, it will need a refund to undo.
payments.screens.attention.failed-conseq: The payment counts as not taken and what it held is released. If the money did arrive, it will need to be returned by hand.
payments.screens.attention.unfulfilled-h: Money was taken but what it was for could not be completed, so it is being refunded in full. These clear once the refund succeeds.
payments.screens.attention.failed-refund: The money has not gone back. Find out why with the provider, then ask for the refund again or hand the money back another way.
payments.screens.attention.empty-help: Payments with no answer, payments being returned, refunds that failed and tills waiting to be counted appear here.
payments.screens.refunds.empty-help: Refunds are asked for from the order or sale they belong to.
payments.screens.refunds.approve-consequ: The money goes back the way it was paid. Cash and card payments taken on another machine are then handed back by a person.
payments.screens.refunds.confirm-consequ: Confirm only once the money is back with the customer. Cash comes out of your open till session.
payments.screens.hand-back.help: These refunds are approved and go back by hand: cash from the till, or a card refund on the machine that took the payment. Give the money back, then press Handed back.
payments.screens.providers.accounts-help: Each account is one way of taking money, such as a Stripe account for online sales or a SumUp account for the card reader.
payments.screens.providers.empty-help: Add an account to take card payments. Cash needs an account too, so that it can be offered at the desk.
payments.screens.providers.available-hel: Add an account with a provider, then save its keys on the account's card above. Keys are kept encrypted in the app.
payments.screens.providers.missing-help: Payments through this account are not offered until its keys are saved below.
payments.screens.providers.label: Name
payments.screens.providers.label-help: What staff see, such as Online card payments or Foyer card reader.
payments.screens.providers.merchant-code: Shown in the SumUp dashboard under your profile.
payments.screens.providers.webhook-help: Give the provider this address so it can tell the site when a payment changes.
payments.screens.providers.about.cash: Cash at the desk, counted into a till session.
payments.screens.providers.about.atteste: A card payment taken on a machine the site cannot talk to. The seller records that it went through.
payments.screens.providers.about.other: Money taken some other way at the desk, such as a voucher, an invoice or a bank transfer. The seller notes what it was.
payments.screens.providers.about.stripe: Card payments online through Stripe, with fees and refunds reported back.
payments.screens.providers.about.sumup: A SumUp Solo reader paired with the site, which sends the amount to the reader. Needs a SumUp account with API access.
payments.screens.providers.about.sumup-h: Opens the SumUp app on the same phone or tablet to take the payment, then comes back. For SumUp accounts without API access, such as one provided by a students' union.
payments.screens.readers.title: Card readers
payments.screens.readers.pair-help: On the reader, open Connections, then API, then Connect. It shows a code to type here.
payments.screens.readers.label: Name
payments.screens.readers.retire-conseque: It is no longer offered for payments. Pair it again to use it.
payments.screens.test.next.waiting-for-r: The amount is on the reader. Pay with a test card, then check.
payments.screens.test.next.handoff: Open the SumUp app to take the payment. It comes back here when done.
payments.screens.test.next.redirect: Open the provider's payment page to finish.
payments.screens.test.next.client-secret: The payment is set up with Stripe. Pay with a test card, such as 4242 4242 4242 4242 with any future date and any security code.
payments.screens.test.next.none: The payment is waiting for its answer.
payments.screens.test.succeeded: The test payment went through. This account works.
payments.screens.test.failed: The test payment did not go through.
payments.screens.payouts.help: Enter a payout from the provider's statement: the money paid into the bank and the fees taken from it.
payments.screens.payouts.fees-help: Only fees not already reported for each payment.
payments.navigation.live-till.label: Till
payments.screens.till.no-session-help: Taking payments at the till needs permission to open a till session. Ask whoever runs your box office.
payments.screens.till.no-panels-help: A module such as the box office or the bar adds what it sells here once it is switched on and you are allowed to use it.
payments.screens.till.sale-help: Change a line, or choose how they are paying.
payments.screens.till.split-one: Splitting needs two or more items.
payments.screens.till.split-help: Give each item to the person paying for it. Each person then pays for their own items.
payments.screens.till.person-nothing: Nothing given to this person yet.
payments.screens.till.receipt-needed: Tickets are sent with the receipt, so add the buyer's email before taking payment.
payments.screens.till.receipt-box.none: Nobody matches. Type their email address to use it.
payments.screens.till.declined: The payment did not go through
payments.screens.till.declined-help: Nothing was taken. Choose a way to pay and try again.
payments.screens.till.waiting-help: Finish the payment on the reader or in the app. This screen checks every few seconds.
payments.screens.till.no-methods: No way to pay at the desk is set up. Ask whoever manages payments to add one.
payments.screens.till.tendered-help: For the change. Leave it empty if they gave the exact amount.
payments.screens.till.cancel-consequence: What was prepared for this sale is released. Nothing has been taken.
payments.screens.till.cancel-waiting: The reader is asked to stop. If it takes the money after all, it is refunded in full.
payments.screens.till.other-note-help: Such as a voucher number or an invoice.
payments.screens.till.unfulfilled: The money was taken but the sale could not be completed
payments.screens.till.unfulfilled-help: It is refunded in full automatically. Needs attention shows it until the refund goes through.
payments.screens.till.picked-up: A payment of {amount} was not finished
payments.screens.till.picked-up-help: Take it now, or cancel it to start again.
payments.screens.till.give-back-conseque: The sale ends and what was prepared for it is released. Hand back the cash, and refund on any card machine or in the SumUp app, before you confirm. A card payment the site took goes back to the card by itself.
payments.screens.till.given-back: Sale ended and payment given back
payments.screens.till.given-back-to-card: {amount} is going back to the card.
payments.screens.till.given-back-unconfi: Confirm the cash on Refunds once it is handed back.
payments.screens.refunds.empty.title: No refunds here
payments.screens.card-form.unavailable: The card form could not load.
payments.screens.card-form.unavailable-r: Check your connection and reload the page. If it still does not load, pay another way or ask the box office.
payments.screens.card-form.failed: The payment could not be made. Nothing has been taken. Try again, or use another card.
payments.screens.card-form.declined: The card was not accepted. Nothing has been taken. Try another card.
payments.screens.card-form.secure: Your card details go straight to Stripe, our payment provider, and are never stored by this site.
payments.screens.session.none-open: You have no session open. The till opens one with your first sale.
payments.screens.session.place-help: Where you are selling. On this device, the till opens your next session here.
payments.screens.till.session-opens: Your session opens with your first sale, at
payments.screens.till.session-menu: Where you are selling, and your session
payments.screens.till.in-progress-help: Nothing in the sale can change until it is paid or cancelled.
payments.screens.till.linked.title: Your devices on the till
payments.screens.till.linked.none: No other device signed in as you has the till open.
payments.screens.till.linked.help-linked: Your devices share one sale and one payment. Disconnecting leaves the sale on the others.
payments.screens.till.linked.help-solo: This device was disconnected, so it is its own till until you link it again.
payments.screens.till.linked.sale-elsewh: This payment was started on {name}. It can be taken on either device.
payments.screens.till.linked.clash: {name} already has a sale with items in it
payments.screens.till.linked.clash-help: Linked devices share one sale. Choose which one to keep.
payments.screens.till.linked.none-joined: No other device has {name}'s till open.
payments.screens.till.linked.help-joined: This device shares {name}'s sale. A payment goes into the session of whoever starts it.
payments.screens.till.linked.someone-els: Show a code here and type or scan it on their device, or enter the code their device shows.
payments.screens.till.linked.code-help: Type this on the other device's till, or scan it with its camera. It runs out in two minutes.
payments.screens.till.linked.code-six: A link code is six digits.
payments.screens.till.linked.ended: The link to {name}'s till has ended
payments.screens.till.linked.adrift-help: This device has lost the other tills, so the sale is held until it is back.
payments.screens.sessions.closed-itself: Closed itself after a quiet spell
payments.screens.attention.awaiting-coun: These sessions stopped with cash in them. Count the cash and close each one under Till sessions.
payments.screens.providers.keys.payments: From Stripe's dashboard, under Developers, API keys. It starts sk_live_, or sk_test_ for a test account.
From the same page. It starts pk_live_, or pk_test_ for a test account. The card form on the booking page loads with it.
Shown in Stripe's dashboard once you add the notification address above. It starts whsec_.
From SumUp's developer settings. It starts payments on a paired card reader.
From SumUp's developer settings, for the app this site is registered as.
The identifier of that app in SumUp's developer settings.
payments.screens.providers.keys.title: Keys
payments.screens.providers.keys.intro: Saved keys are encrypted and never shown again. Saving asks you to confirm it's you.
payments.screens.providers.keys.remove-b: The account stops taking payments until the key is saved again.
payments.quick-actions.sell.label: Sell
